name: RTC_I2C
description: A universal API for a large number of I2C RTCs. Note that not the complete functionality of each RTC is supported. Currently supported RTCs: DS1307, DS1337, DS3231, PCF8523, PCF8563, RS5C372, RV-8523, RV-8803, RV-3032, RV-3028, MCP79140, SD2405

dependencies.name: EpochTime
dependencies.note: An Arduino library with time utilities for handling epoch and broken-down time.
